title: 30A Good Vibes Only
meta_description: Discover 30A Good Vibes Only a 4BR retreat, sleeps 10 with private pool, chef's kitchen, indoor-outdoor living \& easy beach access.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to 30A Good Vibes Only, a stunning coastal retreat in the heart of Blue Mountain/Gulf Place. With a complimentary golf cart included, getting to the beach, local shops, and dining is effortless.

Inside, soaring ceilings and an open-concept layout create a bright, inviting space, while a wall of glass doors seamlessly connects you to the private pool and outdoor entertainment area. The chef-ready kitchen is fully equipped, making group meals easy and enjoyable.

With four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, the home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests---perfect for families and group getaways. Ideally located near both the Gulf and Choctawhatchee Bay, you'll have easy access to beach days, boating, and unforgettable coastal adventures.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Gulf Place and Grayton Beach. The Blue Mountain community is known for having a quieter family atmosphere compared to some of the other communities but still provides ample restaurants, shops and activities.

BEACH ACCESS: Gulfview Heights beach access is the closest to 30a Good Vibes (approximately 3 blocks from the house). It has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season. From the house, turn right on 30A and left at Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street, then 1/4 mile to the gulf.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- Bunk Room, 2 Queen/Queen
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen Room, Ensuite bathroom
• Bedroom 3 -- King Room, Ensuite bathroom
• Bedroom 4 -- King Room, Ensuite bathroom

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private Heated Pool/Spa - available for an additional fee but must be requested at least 48 hours before your stay.
• Pool heat is not available between 4/1 and 11/1.
• Private backyard with entertainment area, tv, table and, lounge area
• Fireplace
• Outdoor kitchen, grill, refrigerator, ice maker
• 2 Bicycles
• Large Chef's kitchen
• Full size washer and dryer on both floors
• Smart TV's throughout the home
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home has room to park 3 vehicles.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
